slightly upward, positioning the illuminated ferris wheel (with colorful 
green gondola cars and blue/purple string lights along the spokes) in 
the blurred background against a dusky blue-gray sky.

blurred), shot on 35mm or 50mm lens, film-like grain, golden hour 
transitioning to blue hour, authentic and unposed feeling despite the 
dynamic pose.

Composition: vertical/portrait orientation, subjects positioned center-right, 
ferris wheel filling upper-left background, low camera angle emphasizing 
the height of the ferris wheel behind them.

Editorial lifestyle photograph, golden hour lighting, aboard a white sailing yacht on open sea with a distant hazy coastline and hills in the background.

He wears an unbuttoned, loose-fitting white linen long-sleeve shirt (sleeves rolled to forearms, chest partially exposed, thin necklace visible) and tailored beige/khaki trousers. His right hand rests casually in his pocket. His left arm is raised overhead, gripping a black rigging rope/mast wrapped in dark tape, wrist wearing a watch and beaded bracelet. He is looking off to the side toward the horizon, in profile, with a relaxed smile.

WOMAN (foreground, seated): A woman with long, wavy dark brown hair cascading over one shoulder, wearing dark oversized sunglasses. She sits reclined on a cream/white cushioned deck seat at the bow, one leg bent and tucked, the other leg extended toward camera, bare feet visible. She wears a flowing white halter-neck midi dress with a high tie collar, fabric draped and flowing naturally. One arm rests behind her for support on the cushion, the other hand rests on her thigh with rings visible. Small tattoo visible on her upper arm/shoulder. She gazes off to the side, calm expression.

SETTING DETAILS: Stainless steel boat railings, rigging lines and ropes crisscrossing the frame diagonally, a dark furled sail visible at far left edge, dark navy mast wrapped in protective tape running vertically through the frame. Deep blue ocean water with soft sunlight glinting off waves. Warm, soft directional sunlight (late afternoon/golden hour) casting warm skin tones and soft shadows. Distant blurred coastline/mountain silhouette on the horizon under a pale sky with light clouds.

STYLE: Shot on a full-frame camera with a shallow-medium depth of field (background softly blurred), natural warm color grading, high-end travel/fashion editorial aesthetic, candid but posed feel, soft contrast, film-like tones.

CAMERA: Eye-level angle, slightly below the standing subject looking up at him, shot from a few feet away on the deck, 35mm–50mm lens look.
